The Swarn Nagari Express is a daily superfast train operated by the Northern Railway zone of Indian Railways. It runs between  in Delhi and  in Rajasthan.
Media reports highlighted that the train will significantly benefit passengers travelling between Delhi, Jaipur, Jodhpur, and Jaisalmer, supporting tourism and regional mobility.
